questions.stemHtml: A 35-year-old male presents with fever, left-sided chest pain, and dyspnea. Upon physical examination, decreased breath sounds are noted on the left side. A chest X-ray reveals the findings presented below. A thoracentesis is performed, yielding a milky white fluid with elevated lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) and the presence of cholesterol crystals. Considering these findings, what underlying agent could be responsible for this presentation?
